root.label: Virginia creates data center utility rate tier

events.label: Virginia creates data center utility rate tier

slots.name: rate tier threshold
slots.sentence: In Virginia, the State Corporation Commission in November 2025 created a separate utility rate tier for energy users demanding 25 megawatts or more, targeting Virginia’s data centers.

slots.name: transmission cost share
slots.sentence: These users must pay at least 85% of contracted transmission and distribution costs, along with 60% of generation costs, regardless of whether that energy is fully used.

slots.name: minimum contract term
slots.sentence: In addition, they must sign contracts for a minimum of 14 years and provide millions of dollars in financial collateral per megawatt.
